key_insight: GALÆXI is an architecture-agnostic, high-order framework enabling efficient simulations of compressible turbulent flows on heterogeneous GPU hardware.
engineering_relevance: This framework facilitates the integration of advanced computational fluid dynamics in various industrial applications by supporting multiple GPU vendors.
method: Utilizes a discontinuous Galerkin spectral element method (DGSEM) for CFD simulations.
Interfaces Fortran code with CUDA C++ for NVIDIA and HIP C++ for AMD to achieve GPU acceleration.
Achieves strong and weak scaling on GPU hardware for large simulations.
evidence_signal: The framework was verified against manufactured solutions, confirming its expected order of convergence and achieving a parallel efficiency of 82.6% with 67.1 billion degrees of freedom.
watch_item: The need for ongoing compatibility with multiple GPU vendors may complicate future updates or optimization efforts.
paper_title: An Architecture-Agnostic High-Order Discontinuous Galerkin Framework for Compressible Flows
